0022600196.text: The 76ers (8-2, 1st in the Atlantic and 1st in the East) visit the Bulls (1-7, 14th in the East) as Philadelphia's 11th game of the season, coming off a loss after winning eight of their last ten. Ariel Hukporti is out with an Achilles injury following surgery, Dominick Barlow is out with a back fracture, and Adem Bona is day-to-day with a back sprain and a game-time decision. Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring strain) and Zach Collins (illness), with Jalen Smith (finger sprain) and Tobe Awaka (knee sprain) also day-to-day and game-time decisions, while the Bulls have lost six straight. Philadelphia leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after its 126-107 win in Philadelphia on November 2, and the 76ers lost 1-2 to Chicago in 2025-26.
